2125338341516378306.en_summary: Some takeaways from this report. $60B of new AI orders in 13 weeks. $132B backlog. Full year raised by $10B. And every order "rigorously vetted for customer quality and access to capital, land and power." That's Dell directly answering the circular financing fear. Demand strong enough that you can turn away unvetted buyers is not what a bubble top looks like. Q4 EPS guides down sequentially on rising component costs, and inventory nearly tripled to feed the backlog. Great quarter, tougher margin road ahead. Bigger picture, Dell is the backbone of this buildout. They assemble the racks, test them, and stand them up. The backbone says demand is accelerating across 7,500+ customers, so everything downstream of those racks eventually gets its piece. Connectivity, power, cooling, all of it.
2125338341516378306.zh_summary: 這份報告的一些要點。13週內600億美元新AI訂單。1320億美元積壓。全年上調100億美元。每個訂單都「嚴格審查客戶質量及資本、土地和電力獲取。」那是Dell直接回應循環融資擔憂。需求強到可以拒絕未審查買家不是泡沫頂部的樣子。Q4 EPS指引因組件成本上升而環比下降，庫存幾乎三倍以餵養積壓。出色季度，前方利潤率道路更艱難。更大圖景，Dell是這次建設的支柱。他們組裝機架、測試並安裝。支柱說需求在7500+客戶中加速，所以那些機架下游的一切最終都會得到其份額。連接、電力、冷卻，所有這些。
